# Legacy Music Group

> Recording and music production at 2815 Main St, Suite A, Dallas, TX 75226, in Deep Ellum.

Phone: (214) 377-9729
Email: info@legacymusicgroup.com

## Services and published rates

Recording: $75/hour, two-hour minimum. Mixing: from $150. Mastering: $30.
Custom production: $500. Music business consultation: $99. Lessons: $100.
Packages list studio time, mixes, masters, and artwork, with photos and video in larger options.
Confirm scope, room, engineer, fees, payment terms, revisions, and delivery with the studio.

## Team

Matthew Medlock: owner and manager. Ray Dallas: head engineer. Wayne: studio engineer and producer. Terry: maintenance engineer.
Profile portraits in this review site are illustrations, not verified team photographs.
